# Launch Screen Assets

These 80/160/240px images are derived from the approved master at
`assets/images/app_icon.png`. Do not substitute a different mark or draw a new
source. Run `python3 tools/generate_branding.py` from the project with Flutter,
Dart and macOS sips available to regenerate them. The launch storyboard keeps
its existing centered 80pt image and navy background.
